problems.reason: Both sentences claim Puertasaurus was among the largest sauropods, repeating the same size claim.
Sentence 19 presents conflicting age ranges for the Cerro Fortaleza Formation and Puertasaurus, contradicting each other.

notes: - contradiction: "Recent studies date the Cerro Fortaleza Formation, where Puertasaurus fossils were found, to between 76 and 70 million years ago, while other studies indicate the deposits belong to the Cerro Fortaleza Formation, dating to the Campanian or Maastrichtian stages, and Puertasaurus lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.": Sentence 19 presents conflicting age ranges for the Cerro Fortaleza Formation and Puertasaurus, contradicting each other.
